facts.fact: The Congolese government signed a 20-year public-private partnership in June 2025 with Singapore-based Trident Digital Tech (via Trident Digital Tech DRC Africa SAS) for the RDC-PASS national digital ID platform, which the Ministry of Planning costs at US$97.1 million and the document's deal record lists Trident as financier; the text itself states the cost estimate, not Trident's own contribution.

systems.owner: Government of DR Congo (Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and New ICTs)

note: One state-brought fact; no money-committed fact because the amount is the ministry's cost estimate and the recipient is the state.
